name: 10201-varoutput-qwen8b-dp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B -- ungated, bf16, ~16 GB of weights, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, one node (four of its eight cards).
parallelism: DP=4, TP=1, EP=1, PP=1 -- four full replicas, one per GPU, behind one HTTP endpoint. `enable_dp_attention` at its default of off.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 16 req/s, warmup the first 30%, bound 3000 requests with a 1200 s safety cap, seed 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts 512 +/- 256 tokens clamped [64, 2048], generations 256 +/- 384 clamped [8, 2048], lengths exact (`max_tokens` with `ignore_eos: true`).
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant answering single-turn questions of varied length at sixteen requests per second on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang 0.5.2 (commit ca63f075b7d8cef11576bc2f8d3f2ebf32228604) `launch_server` arguments.
# host / port / served-model-name are set by whatever starts the server; anything not
# listed here stays at the pinned commit's own default.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
dp-size: 4
tp-size: 1
max-running-requests: 48
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
context-length: 8192
random-seed: 42
